QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Hide-and-Seek
QuestInfo.0: Leon told you that he felt like he was going in circles during his investigation inside the barrier. And he wanted to show you something he found at the place where Delfinos disappeared. You just needed to speak to him again.
QuestInfo.1: Leon told you that he felt like he was going in circles during his investigation inside the barrier. And he wanted to show you something he found at the place where Delfinos disappeared. It looked like a piece of a map. You decided to find the rest of the map by defeating the Delfinos.
QuestInfo.2:
Leon told you that he felt like he was going in circles during his investigation inside the barrier. And he wanted to show you something he found at the place where Delfinos disappeared. It looked like a piece of a map. You decided to find the rest of the map by defeating the Delfinos.

You completed the map by collecting rest of the pieces. That gave you a way into the deep parts of the canal, using the completed map.
